main.description: Delete a device's ORF server state (revocation, SPEC 5.6). Idempotent. ORF endpoint ([CB-17]): states are per device of the caller DID; the server never reveals one. Requires a bound Labyrinth device (a current, non-virtual device registered by the calling chat device). Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
